name: Kashima Jingu
description: Kashima Jingu is one of Japan's Three Great Shrines (Nihon San-daijingu) together with Ise and Katori, and one of the oldest shrines in the Kanto region, founded in 660 BC. It enshrines Takemikazuchi-no-kami, the god of martial arts and swordsmanship, and its precincts include an ancient forest and a national treasure-class straight sword kept in the treasury.
highlights: One of Japan's Three Great Jingu
Famous for martial-arts and victory prayers
notes: Grounds open 24 hours, free of charge. Treasury 9:00-16:00 (separate fee). Kashima Jingu forms the 三大神宮 (Three Great Jingu) with Ise Grand Shrine and Katori Jingu, a trio rooted in the Engishiki shrine records. About 95 min from Tokyo by JR/Narita Line via Kashima Jingu Station.
